data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Act.act-4
data.value: Act IV · The Badge Has Teeth

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.rain-office.Body
data.value: Rain writes crooked lines down the office glass. The city outside is all wet pavement, tired neon and the kind of traffic that never quite stops. At twelve seventeen, Evelyn Vane walks in without an appointment. Her husband, Arthur Vane, left the Hotel Mirabelle yesterday evening and never came home. The police logged it as a rich man taking a private night away. Evelyn does not believe them. Neither does the envelope of cash she sets on your desk.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ask-timeline
data.value: Start with the timeline. Make her account precise.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ask-ivory-room
data.value: Ask why the Ivory Room name is written on the back of Arthur's hotel card.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.take-case
data.value: Take the case and go straight to the Hotel Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.timeline-clean.Body
data.value: Evelyn answers in the clipped rhythm of someone who has rehearsed the story because nobody official listened the first time. Arthur checked into room 306 at 6:42 p.m. He called home at 8:03. A hotel porter saw him return from the street at 9:11. At 9:28, the switchboard recorded an outgoing connection from his room. After that, seventeen minutes are missing from the hotel's internal log. Evelyn never mentions those seventeen minutes until you make her walk through the sequence twice.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.timeline-to-hotel
data.value: Go to the Mirabelle before the night staff changes.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.timeline-frayed.Body
data.value: The sequence refuses to settle. Evelyn remembers the call, the hotel, the rain, and the fact that Arthur sounded afraid, but exact times slide away from her. Whether that is grief, exhaustion or concealment is impossible to tell tonight. You still get one useful fact: room 306, Hotel Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.frayed-to-hotel
data.value: Work with what you have. Go to the Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.crooked-crown.Body
data.value: Rain needles the windows of the Crooked Crown and turns the road outside into black glass. Mara Vey, the innkeeper, sets a sealed letter beside your cup without asking whether you want it. "A stranger paid well to make sure this reached you." The wax is black. The mark pressed into it is a stag with one antler broken away.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.open-letter
data.value: Break the seal and read the letter.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.inspect-seal
data.value: Inspect the seal before touching the letter.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.question-keeper
data.value: Watch Mara carefully and ask who delivered it.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.greyhaven-road.Body
data.value: By the time the road falls toward Greyhaven, the sea has disappeared behind a wall of pearl-grey fog. Gulls wheel above fields you can no longer see, and every fence post wears a crust of salt. You came for a quiet night's shelter. The village below looks as though it has forgotten how to offer one.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.fog-signs.Body
data.value: The fog is wrong. Wind bends the grass inland, but the bank over Greyhaven barely shifts. Beneath the ordinary smell of brine sits something colder: iron, old stone and extinguished candles. Whatever waits below is not only weather.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.descend-aware
data.value: Keep that in mind and enter the village.

data.name: Adventure.Ui.EmptyBoard
data.value: No evidence pinned yet. The board grows as the investigation uncovers people, places, evidence, leads and theories.

data.name: Adventure.Ui.BoardHelp
data.value: Drag a selected card to rearrange the investigation. Connections follow it live. Right-click a card for board actions. FIT focuses known evidence; FRAME shows the complete workspace boundary.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.ivory-name.Body
data.value: Evelyn's expression changes before her answer does. The Ivory Room is not a hotel bar. It is a private gaming room above the Monarch Casino, technically invitation-only and practically owned by Vincent Moretti. Arthur had sworn he stopped going there months ago. Evelyn found the name on his hotel card this morning, written in his own hand.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.client-closes.Body
data.value: For half a second Evelyn looks at the card instead of you. Then she says the Ivory Room means nothing to her. It is a bad lie, but not a careless one. Push harder now and she may walk. Let it sit and the lie becomes something you can return to later.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hotel-lobby.Body
data.value: The Hotel Mirabelle was built for people who wanted marble to make their sins look expensive. At one in the morning, the lobby is quiet enough to hear the rain ticking against the brass revolving door. The night clerk recognizes Arthur Vane's name immediately, then tries very hard not to.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.clerk-cooperates.Body
data.value: The clerk's resistance gives way all at once. Arthur Vane checked in alone. Nobody signed the visitor book for 306. The room key was never returned, yet housekeeping found the door unlocked at dawn. The clerk produces the duplicate key from beneath the desk and insists you never got it from him.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.switchboard-desk.Body
data.value: The clerk keeps glancing toward the switchboard alcove. The operator has stepped away, leaving the night's call sheet under a glass paperweight. Room 306 appears twice. The second entry has been cut out with a razor so cleanly that the missing strip looks deliberate rather than damaged.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.service-hall.Body
data.value: The front desk closes ranks. Hotels have two maps, though: the one guests see and the one staff use. A service corridor behind the elevators runs past linen storage, maintenance stairs and, eventually, the third floor. The lock on the stair door is old but not decorative.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-arrives.Body
data.value: The lock wins the argument. Before you can decide whether to try again, a voice behind you says your name. Detective Elias Hale stands under the corridor's weak service light with his coat still wet from outside. He says Vane is not a police matter. Then he asks what Evelyn told you. The order of those two statements matters.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-slip.Body
data.value: Hale's eyes move toward the elevator when you mention Vane, then to the third-floor indicator before you ever say the room number. He catches himself a second too late. When you ask how he knows 306, his expression turns flat. 'Everybody knows now,' he says. Nobody in the lobby did.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.hale-lets-pass.Body
data.value: Hale does not answer the question. He steps aside instead, the gesture too deliberate to be kindness. 'Five minutes,' he says. 'Then you were never on this floor.' Whether he is helping you, controlling the scene or waiting to see what you find remains open.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.room-306.Body
data.value: The room has been cleaned badly rather than carefully. One chair is wrong for the table. A dark crescent remains in the carpet where somebody scrubbed until the fibers changed color. A brass cufflink sits beneath the radiator. Half a photograph is trapped behind the wastebasket. There is no body, no suitcase and no sign that Arthur Vane packed before leaving.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.cufflink-detail.Body
data.value: The cufflink is expensive, but the interesting part is the bent stem. It was torn sideways under force. The cleaned stain sits exactly where someone standing near the radiator would have fallen or been driven down. Whatever happened here was physical. Whoever cleaned the room missed the one object that rolled out of sight.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.photo-detail.Body
data.value: The photograph shows Arthur Vane outside the Ivory Room beside Vincent Moretti. A third person has been torn away so precisely that only one gloved hand remains on Vane's shoulder. The picture is old enough to contradict Evelyn's claim that Arthur stopped visiting months ago, but recent enough that the Monarch's winter marquee is visible behind them.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.phone-detail.Body
data.value: The room phone has been opened and reassembled. One screw is fresh. Inside, the line pair carries a tiny bridge clip that would let someone monitor or reroute a call from the service junction. This was not done by a guest improvising with a pocketknife. Somebody with access prepared the room before Vane arrived.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.first-room-conclusion.Body
data.value: By the time you leave room 306, this is no longer a simple disappearance. Someone prepared the room, someone cleaned it, and at least one person with institutional access wants the timeline softened. The case board has its first real shape now: Vane, the Mirabelle, the Ivory Room, Hale, the erased call and the objects the cleaner missed. None of it proves who took Arthur Vane. It proves only that several people need you to believe nothing happened.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.foundation-checkpoint.Body
data.value: The rain is still falling when you step back into the street. The next move can point toward the Ivory Room, the police department, Evelyn Vane's omissions or the missing seventeen minutes. Those routes belong to the next content expansion; the campaign foundation, custom roster and live investigation board are now in place.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ivory-to-hotel
data.value: Pocket the name. Start where Arthur was last seen: the Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.close-to-hotel
data.value: Let the lie stand for now. Go to the Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.talk-clerk
data.value: Convince the night clerk that helping you is safer than obstructing you.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.watch-lobby
data.value: Stay quiet and watch what the staff are trying not to look at.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.bribe-clerk
data.value: Put five coins on the desk and ask for room 306 without another word.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.take-key
data.value: Take the duplicate key and go upstairs.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.copy-log
data.value: Copy the surviving entries and head upstairs.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.pick-service-lock
data.value: Work the service-door lock without drawing attention.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.force-service-door
data.value: Put your shoulder into it and accept the noise.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.answer-hale
data.value: Give him nothing useful and ask why he is here.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.hale-pass-room
data.value: Take the five minutes. Enter room 306.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.study-cufflink
data.value: Examine the brass cufflink and the cleaned stain together.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.study-photo
data.value: Work out what is missing from the torn photograph.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.study-phone
data.value: Trace the telephone cable and compare it with the switchboard story.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.cufflink-conclude
data.value: Pin the cufflink to the board and reconsider the room.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.photo-conclude
data.value: Keep the photograph. The casino is now part of the case.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.phone-conclude
data.value: The missing call was engineered. Add it to the board.
